services.desc: Create a Website Account - Manage notification subscriptions, save form progress and more. Property owners or those who operate short-term rentals through platforms such as Airbnb, VRBO, or other online listing services are required to obtain a Town of Lyons Short-Term Rental License and remit local lodging occupation taxes to the Town on a monthly basis. The Town has two different types of licenses; a Short-Term Rental License, and a Special Event Lodging License which allows rentals for the Sundance Film Festival timeframe.
